answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh haven. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. That makes each attestation permanently attributable: a quartz that vouched for junk is a timestamped record the audit lanes can act on later. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each ivory has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal r644t.
